English: She works here, doesn't she?
Chinese: 她在这里工作，不是吗？

English: They can speak English, can't they?
Chinese: 他们会说英语，不是吗？

English: You work for Google, don't you?
Chinese: 你在谷歌工作，不是吗？

English: He works for a bank, doesn't he?
Chinese: 他在银行工作，不是吗？

English: I'm John Smith the telephone engineer.
Chinese: 我是电话工程师约翰·史密斯。

English: I'm Tom the software engineer.
Chinese: 我是软件工程师汤姆。

English: She's Lucy the English teacher.
Chinese: 她是英语老师露西。

English: Sally was invited to a children's party.
Chinese: 莎莉被邀请去参加一个儿童派对。

English: I decided to take her by train.
Chinese: 我决定带她坐火车去。

English: She sat near the window and asked questions.
Chinese: 她坐在窗边问了很多问题。

English: A middle-aged lady got on the train.
Chinese: 一位中年女士上了火车。

English: She sat opposite Sally.
Chinese: 她坐在莎莉对面。

English: The lady took out her powder compact.
Chinese: 那位女士拿出了她的粉盒。

English: She began to make up her face.
Chinese: 她开始化妆。

English: She put away her compact.
Chinese: 她把粉盒收了起来。

English: She asked questions about everything she saw.
Chinese: 她问关于她看到的一切的问题。

English: Sally was sitting near the window when a lady got on.
Chinese: 当一位女士上车时，莎莉正坐在窗边。

English: The lady was dressed in a blue coat.
Chinese: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套。

English: Why are you doing that?
Chinese: 你为什么要那样做？

English: Why was the mother embarrassed?
Chinese: 为什么妈妈感到尴尬？

English: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
Chinese: 莎莉觉得好笑，但我却非常尴尬！

English: Why are you laughing?
Chinese: 你为什么在笑？

English: Why is she crying?
Chinese: 她为什么在哭？

English: She had never travelled on a train before.
Chinese: 她以前从未坐过火车。

English: I have never been to Beijing.
Chinese: 我从未去过北京。

English: He has never flown a plane.
Chinese: 他从未开过飞机。

English: He was happy, but she was sad.
Chinese: 他很高兴，但她很伤心。

English: The book was interesting, but the movie was boring.
Chinese: 这本书很有趣，但电影很无聊。

English: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
Chinese: 游客们被要求保持树林干净整洁。

English: People still throw their rubbish everywhere.
Chinese: 人们仍然到处乱扔垃圾。

English: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
Chinese: 上周三，我去树林里散步了。

English: The ground was covered with pieces of paper.
Chinese: 地面上覆盖着纸屑。

English: Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted.
Chinese: 任何在这些树林里乱扔垃圾的人将被起诉。

English: Hundreds of people come from the city every Sunday.
Chinese: 每周日都有数百人从城市来这里。

English: They like to walk through the woods.
Chinese: 他们喜欢穿过树林。

English: What I saw made me very sad.
Chinese: 我所看到的一切让我非常伤心。

English: My town is surrounded by beautiful woods.
Chinese: 我的城镇被美丽的树林环绕着。

English: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees.
Chinese: 垃圾桶被放在树下。

English: What he said is true.
Chinese: 他所说的是真的。

English: It is a famous beauty spot.
Chinese: 这是一个著名的风景胜地。

English: It is a famous museum.
Chinese: 这是一个著名的博物馆。

English: It is a famous historical site.
Chinese: 这是一个著名的历史遗迹。

English: The road has been closed.
Chinese: 这条路已经被封闭了。

English: The letter has been sent.
Chinese: 信已经被寄出了。

English: What he did made her happy.
Chinese: 他所做的让她很开心。

English: What happened made everyone surprised.
Chinese: 发生的事让每个人都惊讶。

English: Anyone who breaks the rules will be punished.
Chinese: 任何违反规则的人将受到惩罚。

English: Anyone who arrives late will miss the train.
Chinese: 任何迟到的人都会错过火车。
